data.title: Just wanna rug update gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Apr 1, 2024

## [8 days and no shipping yet?](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/660b24cd58c1fbf163ac971e)
Seeing as I ordered 8 days ago and still have yet to receive any update on shipment, I feel as though this is very inadequate. I may be wrong, but I don't think their rugs are made-to-order, so I find it bizarre how long it is taking to ship out my order especially since I ordered to San Diego and their warehouse is in Los Angeles AND it costed $19.95 for shipping!!! SO what's the hold up?

March 25, 2024

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 2, 2024

Hello, we’re sorry to hear you still haven’t received the bath mats that you ordered from us. Apologies for the delays. Our Customer Experience team reached out to you today with an updated ship date, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
